== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Olver]]}}

Olver is annoyed that [[Bela]] is too slow. [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|Faile]]'s people trudge onward with a heavy sense of dread when a curious caravan driver is snapped up by the vines of carnivorous tree. Everyone is horrified and Faile nervously reminds them to stay away from any plants. [[Sandip]] mutters hopelessly that it's the fifteenth dead in just a few days. Only yesterday morning, five were killed by three-eyed [[grolm]].  Olver bemoans the suffering, abandonment, and death of so many people he misses like his parents, [[Jain Charin|Noal]], [[Matrim Cauthon|Mat]], and [[Talmanes Delovinde|Talmanes]]. Again, he resolves to become strong to enact revenge against the [[Shaido]] who killed his father. 

They had abandoned the wagons as they climbed the foothills towards the [[Blasted Lands]]. Faile had Mat's chest of tabac tied to her horse but said it was just a convenient place to stow some of her things. She speaks with [[Chel Vanin|Vanin]] and [[Aravine Carnel|Aravine]] of the growing dangers as they inch closer to the Blasted Lands and [[Shayol Ghul]]. Vanin thinks everywhere will be empty except just around Shayol Ghul when they come across recent wagon tracks. Despite the growing cold, Vanin sweats and suggests they stay holed up someplace nearby. Faile disagrees and pushes them onwards to Shayol Ghul. 

:{{pov|[[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]}}

Cadsuane reflects upon how deep and sophisticated the Shadow's infiltration of the [[The White Tower|White Tower]] must have been and resolves to make the most out of the [[Aiel]]. Although she thinks them untrained, she also finds them useful and gritty, with [[Aviendha]] being exceptional. She explains to Aviendha that no channeling was felt because the [[True Power]] was used by the woman who escaped with [[Sarene Nemdahl|Sarene]]. Since Sarene seemed compulsed, Cadsuane suspected it was [[Graendal]]. [[Sorilea]] argues that Graendal is never mentioned to be so ugly, but agrees it could be a disguise. Aviendha still feels guilty for the deaths of [[Kiruna Nachiman|Kiruna]] and [[Faeldrin Harella|Faeldrin]]. They agree to contact Sorilea, Aviendha, Cadsuane, and [[Amys]] if they even suspect Graendal's presence.

:{{pov|[[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara]]}}

Faile's party is close to Thakan'dar and they have not lost another since drawing close to the border of the Blasted Lands. However, two nights before, Faile is called away from her tent and when she returns the [[Horn of Valere|Horn]]'s chest has been moved slightly. The chest was still locked and the Horn still inside. 

Faile sets a trap to try to catch the traitor in her tent but hides the Horn nearby. A scream pierces the night coming from the area the Horn is hidden. Faile finds [[Harnan]] battling some furry beast while Vanin holds the Horn. Faile shouts that he is a thief and Vanin tosses the Horn and runs, grabbing Harnan on the way. The beast kills a member of [[Cha Faile]] and another one appears, drawn by its cries. [[Arrela Shiego|Arrela]] battles the first while [[Mandevwin]] orders [[Verdin]] and [[Laandon]] to attack with spears. One beast kills Mandevwin's horse, knocking him to the ground. Aravine appears and Faile orders everyone to ride away as she can hear the cries of more of the beasts. 

Faile does not have time to chase Vanin or Harnan if they are to outpace the beasts into the Blasted Lands.
